fret_calculator.title: 🧮  FRET / homoFRET
fret_calculator.subtitle: Combined heteroFRET and homoFRET parameter calculator — convert between distance, efficiency, lifetime and rate.

fret_line.title: 📈  FRET line
fret_line.subtitle: Compute static, dynamic, WLC and mixture FRET lines for parameter ranges, ready to overlay on smFRET 2D histograms.

fcs_calculator.title: 🌀  FCS diffusion
fcs_calculator.subtitle: Confocal-FCS diffusion/volume calculator — solve τ, D, rₕ, V_eff and concentration from one constraint.

rics_precision.title: 📐  RICS precision
rics_precision.subtitle: Predict how precisely a raster scan would measure a diffusion coefficient, and sweep the pixel dwell time to find the one that measures it best — from the intended settings, before acquiring.

phasor.title: ◐  Phasor plot
phasor.subtitle: Interactive phasor plot — universal semicircle with a reference-lifetime grid/ticks, a FRET trajectory and a two-component mixing line.

kappa2_dist.title: 🎯  κ² distribution
kappa2_dist.subtitle: Orientation-factor distribution p(κ²) for FRET — wobbling-in-cone, diffusion-with-traps and isotropic models with apparent-distance error.

f_test.title: 📉  F-test / χ²-max
f_test.subtitle: Compare two nested model fits (confidence ↔ χ² threshold) and compute the χ²-max upper limit of a single fit at a confidence level.

fcs_saturation.title: 🔆  FCS Saturation
fcs_saturation.subtitle: Numerical calculation of excitation saturation and effective volume expansion in FCS across arbitrary multi-state kinetic schemes (e.g. Cy5).

psf_calculator.title: 🔬  PSF calculator
psf_calculator.subtitle: Compute a 3-D point-spread function and view it as a volume: vectorial Richards-Wolf, scalar Airy or Gaussian, with the polarization entering the objective pupil.
